evidence.source_statement: Do not reproduce or reveal private conversations, private drafting language, or nonpublic internal instructions in public outputs merely because they informed the work; public release of the result does not by itself authorize release of its private inputs.
source_conditions: Separate authorization to disclose the private generation context has not been given

interpretation.situation_scope: Relationships describe relevant contexts, not exhaustive triggers or narrower rule applicability.
interpretation.intent_semantics: Intent relationships describe inferred underlying outcomes; normative authority remains with the original rule.
interpretation.effective_rules: No rule, rule profile, or execution instruction is altered by linking.
